step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled current mirror bias circuit, likely used as a sub-block for the VCO or charge pump in the DCPLL. It generates an NMOS bias voltage (N0) from an externally applied PMOS bias voltage (VBIAS), or acts as a self-biased reference if VBIAS is left floating.

V_N0.description: Generated NMOS bias voltage at node N0

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law model with sky130 parameters and forced VBIAS=0.99V.
Based on forced VBIAS=0.99V and sky130 PMOS parameters.

Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias block

sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of currents in both branches multiplied by 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the DC operating point, generated bias voltage, and power consumption of the bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 VBIAS VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VBIAS N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.99
VN1 N1 0 0
VN3 N3 0 0

.control
* DC Operating Point Analysis
op

* Calculate and print metrics
let v_n0 = v(N0)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
let i_bias = i(VN1)

print v_n0
print i_bias
print power

* Transient Analysis for steady-state verification
tran 1n 100n
meas tran v_n0_avg avg v(N0)
meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VVDD)

quit
.endc
.end
